title: GIT_STAGE_FAILED is always classified transient — deterministic pathspec fatals burn the retry budget
notes: Cycle-1098 (2026-07-27): stageExplicitPaths fed git an absolute pathspec ('/go/bin/evolve' from report-token mangling, root-cause fixed console-first the same day) and git fataled rc=128 deterministically. shipErr hardcodes core.ShipClassTransient for GIT_STAGE_FAILED, so recovery retried the byte-identical add twice (budget 2) before aborting — pure burn, and the failure-digest recorded a 'transient' that was nothing of the sort. Design a classification seam: rc=128 with stderr matching git's deterministic fatals (Invalid path, is outside repository, pathspec ... did not match) => config/deterministic class (no retry, straight to retro with the git_stderr field the same fix added); genuine transient shapes (index.lock contention: 'Unable to create .../index.lock', 'File exists') stay transient. Pin both classes with fixtures from real git stderr. Do NOT regex-classify on the message the Go code composes — classify on the captured git_stderr. SECOND live instance same day (cycle-1101): rc=1 'The following paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files' — also deterministic, also retried 2x as transient (root cause fixed console-first via check-ignore pre-filter; this item is ONLY the classification seam). rc=1 advice-refusals belong in the deterministic class fixtures too.
